legend: Alice is a big fan of volleyball and especially of the very strong "Team A".

Volleyball match consists of up to five sets. During each set teams score one point for winning a ball. The first four sets are played until one of the teams scores at least 25 points and the fifth set is played until one of the teams scores at least 15 points. Moreover, if one of the teams scores 25 (or 15 in the fifth set) points while the other team scores 24 (or 14 in the fifth set), the set is played until the absolute difference between teams' points becomes two. The match ends when one of the teams wins three sets. The match score is the number of sets won by each team.

Alice found a book containing all the results of all matches played by "Team A". The book is old, and some parts of the book became unreadable. Alice can not read the information on how many sets each of the teams won, she can not read the information on how many points each of the teams scored in each set, she even does not know the number of sets played in a match. The only information she has is the total number of points scored by each of the teams in all the sets during a single match.

Alice wonders what is the best match score "Team A" could achieve in each of the matches. The bigger is the difference between the number of sets won by "Team A" and their opponent, the better is the match score. Find the best match score or conclude that no match could end like that. If there is a solution, then find any possible score for each set that results in the best match score.
input: The first line contains a single integer m$$$m$$$ (1≤m≤50000$$$1 \le m \le 50\,000$$$) — the number of matches found by Alice in the book.

Each of the next m$$$m$$$ lines contains two integers a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ (0≤a,b≤200$$$0 \le a, b \le 200$$$) — the number of points scored by "Team A" and the number of points scored by their opponents respectively.
output: Output the solution for every match in the same order as they are given in the input. If the teams could not score a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ points respectively, output "Impossible".
Otherwise, output the match score formatted as "x$$$x$$$:y$$$y$$$", where x$$$x$$$ is the number of sets won by "Team A" and y$$$y$$$ is the number of sets won by their opponent.

The next line should contain the set scores in the order they were played. Each set score should be printed in the same format as the match score, with x$$$x$$$ being the number of points scored by "Team A" in this set, and y$$$y$$$ being the number of points scored by their opponent.

legend.ai: Alice 是排球的忠实球迷，尤其是强队“Team A”的球迷。
排球比赛最多进行五局。每局比赛中，球队赢下一个球得 1 分。前四局先打到至少 25 分的球队获胜，第五局先打到至少 15 分的球队获胜。此外，如果一队得到 25 分（第五局为 15 分）而另一队得到 24 分（第五局为 14 分），则继续比赛直到两队分差的绝对值为 2。当一方赢下三局时比赛结束。比赛比分为双方各自赢得的局数。
Alice 找到了一本书，里面记录了“Team A”参加的所有比赛的结果。这本书已经很旧，部分内容变得无法辨认。Alice 无法读到双方各自赢得的局数，也无法读到每局中双方各自的得分，她甚至不知道一场比赛打了多少局。她唯一知道的信息是，在单独一场比赛的所有局中，双方各自的总得分数。
Alice 想知道在每个比赛中，“Team A”可能取得的最好局分是多少。“Team A”赢得的局数与对手赢得的局数之差越大，局分就越好。请找出最好的局分，或者判断不存在这样的比赛结果。如果存在解，还要给出任意一组能达成该最好局分的每局得分。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 m$$$m$$$(1≤m≤50000$$$1 \le m \le 50\,000$$$)——表示 Alice 在书中找到的比赛场数。
接下来的 m$$$m$$$ 行中的每一行包含两个整数 a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$(0≤a,b≤200$$$0 \le a, b \le 200$$$)——分别表示“Team A”和其对手得到的分数。

output.ai: 按输入中给出的顺序输出每场比赛的方案。如果两队无法分别得到 a$$$a$$$ 分和 b$$$b$$$ 分，则输出 "Impossible"。
否则，按照 "x$$$x$$$:y$$$y$$$" 的格式输出比赛比分，其中 x$$$x$$$ 表示“Team A”赢得的局数，y$$$y$$$ 表示其对手赢得的局数。
下一行应按照各局进行的顺序包含每局的比分。每局比分都应使用与比赛比分相同的格式输出，其中 x$$$x$$$ 表示“Team A”在该局得到的分数，y$$$y$$$ 表示其对手得到的分数。
